# windowsddi_dhcp_scopes (Data Source)

Lists every IPv4 scope on the server (`Get-DhcpServerv4Scope`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "windowsddi_dhcp_scopes" "all" {}

output "active_scope_ids" {
  value = [for s in data.windowsddi_dhcp_scopes.all.scopes : s.scope_id if s.state == "Active"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `scopes` (Attributes List) All IPv4 scopes, ordered as the server returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scopes))

<a id="nestedatt--scopes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scopes`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Scope description.
- `end_range` (String) Last address of the range.
- `lease_duration` (String) Lease duration as `d.hh:mm:ss`.
- `name` (String) Scope name.
- `scope_id` (String) Scope ID (network address).
- `start_range` (String) First address of the range.
- `state` (String) Scope state as reported by the server (`Active` or `Inactive`).
- `subnet_mask` (String) Subnet mask.
- `type` (String) Clients served: `Dhcp`, `Bootp` or `Both`.
